name: dsh-plugin-manager
description: A floating-ball plugin manager for DeepSeek Harness. A plugin declares dsh.ball in its package.json and gets a list entry, a generated settings form, a Plugins-page card, and an enable switch; a frosted-glass skin ships as the first plugin that uses it.

scripts.test: node test/verify-ball.mjs && node test/verify-ball-host.mjs && node test/verify-glass.mjs && node test/verify-together.mjs
